title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - First Action - Opposing Counsel's Error
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: During a trial, opposing counsel accidentally drops a page from their notebook, which contains their confidential cross-examination strategy. The paralegal picks it up and realizes what it is. What is the **first action** the paralegal must take?
options: Photograph the page for their own file before returning it.
Immediately read the strategy to best prepare their client.
Stop reading it, inform opposing counsel, and return the document unread.
Give the document to the judge and ask for a mistrial.
questions.explain: Similar to inadvertent electronic disclosure (Rule 3.03), handling opposing counsel's confidential materials obtained by mistake requires the paralegal to act ethically and in good faith. The paralegal must not exploit the mistake; they must immediately stop reading, notify the opposing side, and return or destroy the document as instructed.
